name: Slippery Character
body:
You quickly react to spells with the [cold descriptor].

Prerequisite(s): Improved Lightning Reflexes, Lightning Reflexes.

Benefit(s): Whenever you succeed on a Reflex saving throw against a spell or spell-like ability with the [cold descriptor], you may as an immediate action move a number of squares across a surface covered by ice or snow up to the level of the spell. You cannot move a distance greater than your base speed regardless of the spell’s level. You must walk across the surface to gain the preceding benefit. Furthermore, the saving throw must be made in response to an enemy’s actions.

Saving throws caused by your actions or those of your allies grant you no ability to move.
